name: turnScriptToAudio
description: Convert a podcast script into an MP3 file with Amazon Polly and return a presigned S3 URL.

script_json.description: A JSON array string of script lines. Each line should include speaker and text.

audio_url.description: A presigned URL for the generated MP3 file.

s3_bucket.description: The S3 bucket containing the generated MP3.

s3_key.description: The S3 key for the generated MP3.
